## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link the issue (use `Closes #...` only when complete).

## Validation

- Automated: command, result, and environment.
- Hardware (when audio behavior changes): device/setup, performed cases, and results.
- Not tested: list relevant cases and why.

## Risks and maintenance

Describe any permission, saved-state, compatibility, dependency, or distribution impact. Link follow-up work when needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and `bash scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Relevant docs and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No device identifiers, credentials, private logs, or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Hardware claims reflect tests actually performed (or no hardware behavior changes).
